words.gloss: in the presence of the robbed
country, caste, lineage, name, action, valuables, associates, residence

hindi: लुटे हुए की उपस्थिति में, बाहरी और भीतरी साक्षियों की उपस्थिति में, अभियुक्त से उसके देश, जाति, गोत्र, नाम, कर्म, बहुमूल्य वस्तुओं, सहायकों और निवास के विषय में पूछताछ करे।
english: In the presence of the robbed, and of witnesses, outer and inner, he should question the accused about [his] country, caste, lineage, name, action, valuables, associates and residence.
notes: muṣita (ppp. of √muṣ) is taken as 'the robbed [person]' (plain substantive). bāhya/abhyantara sākṣin = witnesses 'outer and inner' (the text does not say who they are). karma in the list is the glossary 'action'; 'occupation' is the likely sense. sāra = valuables per glossary (also 'property, substance'). The subject of anuyuñjīta (the investigating officer) is not stated.

hindi: और उनका अपदेशों से मिलान करे।
english: And he should compare those with the apadeśas (pretexts).
notes: apadeśa is left as a literal 'pretext' (also 'reference, assigned statement'); the exact sense (the statements given by the accused or by the persons he names) is not settled by the line. 'Those' (tān) refers back to the particulars of unit 1 only by inference; nothing is supplied. pratisamānayet is literally 'bring together (to match) with'.

hindi: फिर पिछले दिन के विचरण और रात में निवास के विषय में, पकड़े जाने तक, पूछताछ करे।
english: Then he should question [him] about the previous day's movement and [his] stay at night, up to the arrest.
notes: 'cā grahaṇāt' = ca + ā grahaṇāt ('and up to the seizing'). The closing iti is not rendered (it closes the list of matters of inquiry). The object 'him' is not stated.

words.gloss: in the matching of the going-away (apasāra)

hindi: उसके अपसार का मिलान होने पर वह निर्दोष हो; अन्यथा कर्म को प्राप्त है।
english: If his apasāra (going away) is matched up, he would be cleared; otherwise, [he is] one who has reached action.
notes: apasāra is taken literally as 'going away' (his departure/movements); the glossary has 'place of retreat' for 10.2, a different sense. pratisandhāna = joining, matching. śuddha is literally 'pure' (cleared of the charge). karma-prāpta = 'one who has come to action', i.e. liable to the 'action' of unit 14ff.; the text does not say more. The verb is supplied only as the copula.

hindi: तीन रात के बाद संदिग्ध पकड़ने योग्य नहीं है, पूछताछ के अभाव से; उपकरण के दिखाई देने को छोड़कर।
english: After three nights the suspected one is not to be seized, from the absence of questioning, except on seeing the implements.
notes: The sentence is elliptical. agrāhya is literally 'not to be seized' (held, kept in custody); the reason clause 'from absence of questioning' could instead qualify the exception. upakaraṇa = implements/equipment (burglars' tools or stolen articles are both possible; the text does not say).

words.gram: pres. part. m. gen. sg. abhi-vi-ā-√hṛ
pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. pra-√chad

hindi: जो चोर नहीं है उसे “चोर” कहने वाले को चोर के समान दण्ड है, और चोर को छिपाने वाले को भी।
english: For one who declares a non-thief “a thief”, the punishment is equal to a thief's; and for one who hides a thief.
notes: The closing iti closes the quoted word 'thief' and is shown by the quotation marks only. 'Equal to a thief's' is the punishment (daṇḍa) of a thief, not specified. The final 'and for one who hides a thief' takes the same punishment by ellipsis.

hindi: चोर द्वारा अभियुक्त किया गया, वैर और द्वेष से नामजद किया गया, निर्दोष हो।
english: One accused by a thief, named out of enmity and hatred, would be cleared.
notes: apadiṣṭaka (apa-√diś, 'pointed out, named') is taken as 'the one named'; 'falsely pointed at' is an alternative colouring. The instrumental dual vaira-dveṣābhyām is read as the reason ('out of').

words.gram: pres. part. caus. m. gen. sg. pari-√vas

hindi: निर्दोष को रोके रखने वाले को प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: For one who keeps a cleared man detained, [there is] the first fine for rashness.
notes: parivāsayati is literally 'causes to stay around' (keeps confined, detains); the sense of confinement is inferred from the context. 'First' (pūrva) fine = the first grade of the sāhasa fines; the text does not define it in this line. Only the copula is supplied.

words.gloss: the doers of implement, counsellor, associate, form and service

hindi: शंका से सिद्ध हुए को, उपकरण, मन्त्री, सहायक, रूप और वैयावृत्य करने वालों को निष्पादित करे।
english: One established through suspicion — he should bring about the doers of implement, counsellor, associate, form and service.
notes: DOUBTFUL. The syntax is unclear: śaṅkā-niṣpanna may be the object of niṣpādayet, or the whole may mean 'in the case of one established through suspicion, he should have [him/them] produce...'. -kara is read as 'doer, maker'; rūpa may be 'form' (appearance) or, as in 5.2, 'coin'; vaiyāvṛtya = service, attendance. The rendering is deliberately literal and no sense has been chosen between these.

words.gloss: by place, goods, taking, share and division

hindi: और कर्म का स्थान, द्रव्य, ग्रहण, अंश और विभाग से मिलान करे।
english: And he should compare the action with the place, goods, taking, share and division.
notes: karmaṇaḥ is taken as the deed (the act charged) in the genitive, 'compare [the account] of the action'; an ablative reading ('from the action') is possible. 'The account' is not supplied in the translation.

words.gram: pres. part. m. acc. sg. vi-pra-√lap

hindi: इन कारणों का मेल न होने पर बकवास करने वाले को अचोर जाने।
english: When these grounds are not connected up, he should know one who babbles [to be] a non-thief.
notes: kāraṇa is rendered 'grounds' (also 'causes, means, instruments'); the line does not say which. vipralap = to talk wildly/inconsistently; 'babble' is literal. anabhisandhāna = non-joining (the particulars do not tally).

words.gloss: by similarity of a thief's dress, weapons and goods

words.gram: pres. pass. part. m. nom. sg. √grah

words.gloss: from fear of the affliction of action

words.gram: pres. part. mid. m. nom. sg. √brū

hindi: क्योंकि देखा जाता है कि चोर न होने वाला भी चोरों के मार्ग में संयोग से मिल जाने पर चोर के वेश, शस्त्र और सामान की समानता से पकड़ा जाता है, अथवा चोर के सामान के पास रहने से; जैसे अणि-माण्डव्य ने, चोर न होते हुए भी, कर्म के क्लेश के भय से “मैं चोर हूँ” कहा।
english: For it is seen that even a non-thief, on a chance meeting on a thieves' path, is seized because of similarity in a thief's dress, weapons and goods, or by dwelling near a thief's goods; as Ani-Mandavya, a non-thief, from fear of the affliction of action, saying “I am a thief”.
notes: upavāsa (upa-√vas) is literally 'dwelling near' (alternative: fasting/staying with); the sense 'being found staying beside the thief's goods' is not stated. karma-kleśa = 'affliction of action' (the torture of units 14ff.). The quotation “coro 'smi” is opened and closed. In English the participle bruvāṇaḥ is left hanging from 'as Ani-Mandavya', following the Sanskrit; the Hindi turns it into a finite verb. The name is the only person named; nothing of his story is imported.

hindi: इसलिए जिसका करण समाप्त हो चुका है उसे नियन्त्रित करे।
english: Therefore he should restrain [him] whose karaṇa is complete.
notes: DOUBTFUL. samāpta-karaṇam may be a bahuvrīhi 'one whose karaṇa (procedure/means) is completed' or a neuter object 'the completed karaṇa' (the finished procedure) with niyamayet 'should regulate'. karaṇa is left as the Sanskrit word. The adjacent units give no sure help.

words.gloss: tired by hunger, thirst and the road

hindi: मन्द अपराध वाले, बालक, वृद्ध, रोगी, मत्त, उन्मत्त, भूख, प्यास और मार्ग से थके हुए, अधिक खाए हुए, कच्चा खाए हुए अथवा दुर्बल को कर्म न कराए।
english: He should not have action done to one of slight offence, a child, the aged, the sick, the intoxicated, the insane, one tired by hunger, thirst or the road, one who has overeaten, one who has eaten raw [food], or the weak.
notes: āmaka-aśita: āmaka is 'raw, unripe' (āma + -ka); 'food' is supplied in brackets in English only; 'undigested' is an alternative sense. mattam and unmattam are both ppp. of √mad (intoxicated; mad). The Hindi uses 'कच्चा खाए हुए' literally. 'Action' (karma) is the glossary word; the sense is torture, which is not stated here.

words.gloss: by [those of] character, unchaste women, prāpāvikas, givers of an opportunity for talk, and givers of food

hindi: समान शील वालों, पुंश्चलियों, प्रापाविकों, बातचीत का अवसर देने वालों और भोजन देने वालों के द्वारा अपसर्पण कराए।
english: By [those of] similar character, unchaste women, prāpāvikas, givers of an opportunity for talk and givers of food, he should cause apasarpa (secret going-about).

text_flags.why: possible: tulya stands alone while the other members are joined by '.'; likely a missing compound mark so that tulya-śīla (of similar character) is one member

notes: DOUBTFUL. apasarpa is 'spy' in the glossary; apasarpayet is the causative of apa-√sṛp ('cause to go away/creep'), probably 'set apasarpas (agents) going' but the object and sense are not stated, so it is left literal. prāpāvika is obscure (from prāpā 'water-hut'; keeper?) and is kept untranslated. The dvandva list may also be read as 'through persons of like character, namely unchaste women, ... '.

words.gloss: in the misappropriation of a deposit

hindi: इस प्रकार छल ले, अथवा जैसा निक्षेप के अपहार में बताया गया है।
english: In this way he should outwit [him], or as has been explained in the misappropriation of a deposit.
notes: atisandadhyāt = 'outwit' per glossary 9.1/9.3; the object is not stated. The reference is to an earlier explanation about deposits (not imported here). apahāra = taking away, misappropriation.

hindi: जिसका दोष सिद्ध हो चुका है उससे कर्म कराए, किन्तु स्त्री से कदापि नहीं, गर्भवती से, सूतिका से, अथवा एक मास से कम पहले प्रसव करने वाली से।
english: He should have action done to one whose fault is established, but never to a woman — a pregnant one, a sūtikā, or one delivered [less than] a month [ago].
notes: māsa-avara-prajātā is uncertain: avara can mean 'lower, less' (delivered less than a month ago) or 'at the lowest, at least'; the rendering 'less than a month' is a choice and the brackets in English mark the supplied words. sūtikā = a woman recently delivered / in childbed. āpta-doṣa: āpta = obtained, established (also 'trustworthy'); 'one whose fault is established'.

hindi: स्त्री के लिए तो आधा कर्म, अथवा वाक्य से पूछताछ।
english: For a woman, however, half the action, or questioning by words.
notes: anuyoga is rendered 'questioning', in line with anuyuñjīta in unit 1 (the 5.4 glossary 'instruction' does not fit here). Only the genitive 'for a woman' and the bare nominatives are given; no verb is supplied. 'Half the action' is the half of the action stated for others (literal).

words.gloss: the taking up of a secret agent

hindi: श्रुतवान् और तपस्वी ब्राह्मण का गुप्तचर-परिग्रह है।
english: For a brāhmaṇa — a learned one and an ascetic — the sattri-parigraha.
notes: DOUBTFUL. sattri = sattrin (secret agent); parigraha = taking, seizing, surrounding; the compound is kept as a term in English (literally 'the taking up of a secret agent'); the Hindi follows the glossary (गुप्तचर). Whether it means keeping the brāhmaṇa under watch by agents or something else is not stated. The words śrutavat and tapasvin are both genitive, parallel to brāhmaṇasya; the 'and' joins the learned and the ascetic (they may be two persons).

hindi: इसका अतिक्रम करने पर उत्तम दण्ड है, कर्ता और करवाने वाले के लिए, कर्म से और वध से।
english: For a transgression of that, [there is] the highest punishment, for the doer and for the causer, by action and by killing.
notes: 'That' (tasya) refers to the preceding rule on the brāhmaṇa (unit 19). The two instrumentals are read as the manner of the punishment ('by action, and by killing'); it could also mean the offence ('for action and for killing'). 'Highest' (uttama) punishment is not defined here.

hindi: व्यावहारिक कर्म-चतुष्क — छह डंडे, सात कशा, दो उपरि-निबन्ध और उदक-नालिका।
english: The vyāvahārika group of four actions — six rods, seven whips, two upari-nibandhas, and the water-tube.
notes: vyāvahārika is left as the word (here 'relating to legal procedure'); the Hindi keeps व्यावहारिक as in the glossary. daṇḍa = rod (not 'army' or 'punishment' here); kaśā = whip (strokes are possible). upari-nibandha is obscure (literally 'binding above/upon') and kept untranslated. udaka-nālikā = literally 'water-tube', its use is not stated.

words.gloss: of one who has drunk gruel
of one who has drunk oil

hindi: आगे, पापकर्म करने वालों के लिए: नौ वेत्र-लताएँ, बारह कशा, जाँघों के दो वेष्टन, बीस नक्त-माल-लताएँ, बत्तीस तल, दो वृश्चिक-बन्ध, दो उल्लम्बन, हाथ की सूई; यवागू पिए हुए की अँगुली के एक पोर का जलाना; स्नेह पिए हुए का एक दिन तपाना; और शिशिर की रात में बल्बज के अग्रभागों की शय्या।
english: Further, for those of evil action: nine cane-lashes, twelve whips, two thigh-bindings, twenty nakta-māla lashes, thirty-two palm [blows], two scorpion-bindings, and two hangings, a needle [for] the hand; for one who has drunk gruel, the burning of one joint of a finger; for one who has drunk oil, heating for one day; and, on a cold night, a bed of balbaja tips.
notes: param pāpa-karmaṇām could also be 'for the worst of those of evil action'. vetra-latā = cane (rattan) switch; nakta-māla is a tree name kept as a name; tala = palm (slap), 'blows' is bracketed; balbaja is a grass (name kept, not identified in Hindi). sūcī hastasya is literally 'a needle of the hand' (the exact use is not stated). 'Gruel' (yavāgū) and 'oil/fat' (sneha) are literal. The list is a numbered litany, no explanation added. The unit's items are counted in unit 23 as 'eighteenfold'; no count is checked here.

hindi: यह अठारह का कर्म है।
english: Such is the action [group] of eighteen.
notes: Closing iti before a label: shown as 'Such is' / 'यह', not 'thus'. aṣṭādaśaka = a group of eighteen (aṣṭādaśan + -ka). The brackets in English supply 'group' only.

hindi: उसका उपकरण, प्रमाण, प्रहरण, प्रधरण और अवधारण खर-पट्ट से प्राप्त कराए।
english: He should have its implement, measure, striking, pradharaṇa and fixing brought out from the khara-paṭṭa.

text_flags.why: possible: '.' marks compound members but tasya is a separate word (genitive); the e-text elsewhere uses '-' for such an unsandhied join (tasya-apasāra)

notes: khara-paṭṭa is literally 'rough/hard slab or cloth'; it is kept as a word. pradharaṇa is obscure (pra-dhṛ; 'bearing, holding') and left untranslated. āgamayet (caus. of ā-√gam) = 'cause to come', i.e. have brought out/made known; 'have learned' is an alternative. 'That' (tasya) refers to the action of unit 23.

hindi: और एक-एक कर्म, एक दिन के अन्तर से, कराए।
english: And he should have action done one at a time, with a day's interval.
notes: eka-ekam is read as 'one by one' (one kind at a time); that the kinds are those of units 21-22 is inferred and not stated. divasa-antaram is adverbial, 'with an interval of a day'.

words.gram: pres. part. m. acc. sg. apa-√hṛ

words.gloss: one in whom goods are seen in one place

words.gram: pres. part. m. acc. sg. ava-√stṛ

words.gloss: one to be killed by action

hindi: राजा की आज्ञा से, पहले किए हुए अपदान को स्वीकार करके उसे वापस लेने वाले से, जिसका सामान एक स्थान पर दिखाई दिया हो उससे, कर्म या रूप से पकड़े गए से, राजकोश को ढँकने वाले से, अथवा कर्म से वध्य से कर्म कराए — संयुक्त, पृथक् या बार-बार।
english: On the king's word he should have action done — combined, separate or repeated — to one who, having admitted a deed done earlier, withdraws [it]; to one in whom goods are seen in one place; to one seized by action or by form; to one covering over the royal treasury; or to one to be killed by action.
notes: Several doubtful words, rendered literally: apadāna (a deed, exploit); apaharantam (apa-√hṛ: withdraws; alternatives 'denies, conceals, carries off'); karmaṇā rūpeṇa vā gṛhīta ('seized by action or by form': in the act, or by appearance/token; rūpa as 'coin' in 5.2 is another possibility); avastṛṇantam ('covering over', the sense 'embezzling/concealing' is not stated); karma-vadhya ('to be killed by action' or 'to be killed for the deed'). samasta/vyasta/abhyasta are read as the manner of the action (combined, separate, repeated). The Hindi is a free-standing sentence with the manner placed last.

hindi: सब अपराधों में ब्राह्मण पीड़ित करने योग्य नहीं है।
english: In all offences a brāhmaṇa is not to be afflicted.
notes: apīḍanīya = 'not to be afflicted' (pīḍana = affliction in the glossary); the extent (the 'action' of the previous units, or any pain) is not stated.

words.gloss: for the fall from legal dealings
in the killing of a man

hindi: उसके ललाट पर अभिशस्त का चिह्न हो, व्यवहार से पतन के लिए: चोरी में कुत्ता, मनुष्य-वध में कबन्ध, गुरु-शय्या में भग, सुरापान में मद्य-ध्वज।
english: For him there should be on the forehead the mark of the accused, for the fall from legal dealings (vyavahāra): in theft a dog, in the killing of a man a headless trunk, in the teacher's bed the female organ (bhaga), in drinking surā a liquor-banner.

text_flags.why: possible: loc. sg. steye (in theft) is expected beside the parallel locatives manuṣya-vadhe, guru-talpe, surā-pāne; 'steyo śvā' is ungrammatical sandhi (steyaḥ would stay steyaḥ before ś)

notes: 'For him' (tasya) is the brāhmaṇa of unit 27. vyavahāra-patana is literally 'falling from legal dealing' (exclusion from legal proceedings and dealings). Only the copula is supplied. guru-talpa is left as 'the teacher's bed'. dhvaja = banner/flag.

words.gloss: with a wound made by the brand

hindi: पापकर्म करने वाले ब्राह्मण को, जिसके अंक से घाव बना दिया गया हो, घोषित करके राजा उसे देश से बाहर कर दे अथवा खानों में बसाए।
english: Having proclaimed a brāhmaṇa of evil action, with the wound made by the brand, the king should make him one without a country, or settle him in the mines.
notes: The two lines form one sentence (a verse). aṅka-kṛta-vraṇa is read as 'the wound made by the brand' (the mark of unit 28). nirviṣaya = literally 'without a territory', i.e. banished. ākara = mine (place of working). vāsayet = literally 'cause to dwell'.
